title: Approval routes
createHint: Each template and plant has one route; set up its steps, and once it passes the launch check it can be ticked in the annual launch.
plantHint: Only the plants this template applies to are listed.
groupEmpty: No approval routes in this component
unclassifiedHint: The templates of these routes have no component yet: open the template under Templates, press "Edit" and choose one under "Edit header".
empty: No approval routes to show (only audit admins can see the route editor)
notFound: This approval route does not exist, or you may not view it
notReady: The launch check does not pass yet: this combination cannot be ticked in the annual launch

problems.missingUnits: These assessing units have no branch yet: {{units}}. Create their branches.
problems.unusedUnits: The template no longer has control points for these assessing units, so their branches have nothing to answer; delete them: {{units}}.
problems.branchFirstStep: The first step of these branches is not the self-checker: {{units}}.
problems.noMergeSteps: There are no steps after the merge: once every branch is approved there must be a next step (plant manager, audit review).
problems.pendingUnits: {{count}} control points of the template still have the placeholder unit 待指定單位; set their real units in template management.
problems.unassignedSteps: These steps have no signer assigned yet: {{steps}}. Assign them before the forms go out.

deleteRoute.title: Delete route {{code}} × {{plant}}
deleteRoute.warning: This cannot be undone; the template and plant need a new route, set up step by step, before they can be launched again. Issued assessments are not affected.
deleteRoute.contents: Its {{count}} steps are deleted with it.

editNote: Routes are edited directly, and the launch check above shows the result at once; a combination that fails it cannot be ticked in the annual launch. Issued assessments, including those being signed, are not affected: they copied the steps at launch, and only inserted steps or reassignment change them afterwards.
dragHint: Drag ⠿ to reorder the steps after the merge.
branchesHint: One branch per assessing unit the template uses, filled in at the same time; always self-checker → department manager, with room for one more step. The plant coordinator or the audit chief assigns the signers in Assign signers; the launch copies them onto the assessment.
missingNote: The template uses this assessing unit, but it has no branch yet.
unusedNote: The template no longer has control points for this assessing unit, so this branch has nothing to answer; delete it.
deleteBranchConfirm: Delete the “{{unit}}” branch and all its steps?
mergeBand: Merges once all {{count}} units are approved: {{units}}
mergeBandNone: The template uses no assessing unit: issued assessments start after the merge
addMergedStep: Add a step after the merge
signerPlaceholder: Type a complete employee ID to ask OMS
signerHint: Type the complete employee ID and OMS confirms who it is; one person may hold several steps.
signerOptionalHint: Type the complete employee ID and OMS confirms who it is; one person may hold several steps. Leave it empty to assign it in Assign signers before the launch.
signerUnknown: CSA has no name for this ID yet

errors.notListed: This person is not on the CSA access list and cannot be a signer until a system maintainer lets them in
errors.duplicateRoute: This template and plant already have a route; refresh and edit that one.
errors.stepRule: Step name and signer cannot be blank, and audit review steps are read-only.
errors.forbidden: Only audit admins can edit approval routes
errors.plantNotApplicable: This template does not apply to this plant, so it cannot have an approval route there.
errors.branchExists: This assessing unit already has a branch; refresh and try again.

plantEmpty: This plant has no approval routes yet

lookup.typeAll: Type the complete employee ID (no search by name or part of an ID)

lookup.on_leave: OMS records {{empId}} as on unpaid leave; cannot be chosen
lookup.transferred: {{empId}} is an old ID from before a transfer; use the new ID
lookup.noCsa: (not enabled for CSA in OMS yet)
lookup.no_csa: CSA is not ticked for {{empId}} in OMS; cannot be chosen, ask the OMS administrator
lookup.not_listed: {{empId}} is not on the CSA access list; a system maintainer must let them in first
